english: I went down immediately, of course, and that fool, Horst, aimed a fire extinguisher at me.
text: aimed a fire extinguisher at me 的重点是灭火器竟对准了人，at 标出目标。介绍器具使用出了什么差错，可用 aim something at someone 交代瞄准对象；that fool 则是大使带情绪的评价，不是中性身份。
author: Codex
